Binding Generator

The binding generator adds public binding-aware properties for annotated fields. This allows a custom control to expose properties to C# and MXML without writing the same getter and setter code for each one.

Setting Up the Generator

The MelonUI NuGet package includes the analyzer. If you are using source project references, add an analyzer reference in the project that declares the annotated fields:

Adjust the paths relative to your .csproj. The generator targets netstandard2.0 because it runs as a build tool; MelonUI and the application target .NET 10.

Example Usage

Add the Binding attribute to a mutable instance field in a partial class:

This generates a Caption property. Its behavior is equivalent to the following simplified code; you do not add this property yourself:

Leading underscores are removed, then the first remaining letter is capitalized. For example, _caption becomes Caption, _IsVisible becomes IsVisible, and onActivated becomes OnActivated.

Supported Fields and Classes

  • Fields must be mutable instance fields. Static, readonly and const fields are not supported.
  • The class and every containing class must be nonstatic partial classes.
  • A generated property cannot share a name with another generated, existing or inherited property.
  • Do not declare binding helper members that conflict with the generated helpers. UIElement already provides these methods.

Multiple fields, nested/generic classes, qualified attributes and attribute aliases are supported. Classes in different namespaces can have the same short name.

Using the fully qualified MelonUI.Attributes.Binding attribute avoids ambiguity with the MelonUI.Base.Binding class. MXML binds to the generated public property, not the field.

Compiler Diagnostics

CodeDescription
MUIB001The attribute was applied to an unsupported declaration. Use a mutable field rather than a property or event.
MUIB002The class or one of its containing classes is not a nonstatic partial class.
MUIB003The field is static, readonly or const, so it cannot be generated.
MUIB004The generated property name conflicts with an existing, inherited or generated member.
MUIB005The type declares reserved binding helpers. Remove the conflicting helpers or derive from UIElement.

Using the Generator on Data Classes

A non-UI partial data class can also receive IBindingHost storage. Generated setters support binding, but they do not automatically implement INotifyPropertyChanged. Add notifications yourself when you want consumers to be invalidated efficiently.

If you install bindings directly on a non-UI object, remove them when they are no longer needed. UIElement normally handles that lifetime for its own bindings.
